description: Cold-start byte budgets for the DT, BRD, PRD, ADR, and planner chain. Bytes cover what the Copilot agent harness loads when the agent starts: the agent file, the SKILL.md of every skill in its skills list, and instructions that load into every main session, with CRLF normalized to LF. Above ceiling fails; above target warns. Targets are the measured cold-start bytes rounded up to the next 1,000; ceilings add about 10 percent, rounded up to the next 1,000, to absorb growth in shared skills such as disclaimer-language. Raise a ceiling only for growth in a shared file the agent does not own.

.github/agents/accessibility/accessibili.rationale: Measured 23,564 bytes: the agent plus the preloaded untrusted-content-boundary skill. planner-identity loads by name and is not counted.
